nodes.description: Immutable reference to the Changelog contract used to resolve MCD_PAUSE.
Timestamp at which the spell becomes executable; written in schedule().
Encoded function selector 'execute()' passed to the pause proxy.
Flag preventing the spell from being cast twice.
Immutable spell tag derived from extcodehash of the action contract.
Immutable address of the DssSpellAction contract that holds the logic.
Timestamp after which scheduling is no longer allowed.
Immutable PauseAbstract proxy used for plot/exec scheduling.
Human readable spell description string.
Constant description of the March 2021 executive spell.
Constant address of the LERP contract being deauthorized.
Internally deployed DssSpellAction instance used by the spell.
Virtual office-hours toggle returning true by default.
External entry point of the action, guarded by the limited modifier.
Virtual function overridden by concrete spells to encode governance actions.
Modifier restricting execution to weekday office hours using block.timestamp.
Internal helper performing full collateral onboarding through DssExecLib.
Reads office-hours flag from the linked action contract.
Computes the next valid cast timestamp honoring office hours.
Sets pause proxy, description, expiration, action, sig and tag.
Schedules the spell via pause.plot after validating expiration.
Executes the scheduled spell through pause.exec.
Override disabling office hours for this spell.
Performs the concrete governance changes: LERP deauthorization, PSM-USDC-A ceiling increase, USDC-A ceiling reduction and global Line adjustment.
Deploys the action and initializes DssExec with a 30 day expiration.
Block timestamp consumed by the limited modifier for weekday/hour checks.
Block timestamp compared with eta in nextCastTime.
now used in schedule() to bound expiration and derive eta.
block.timestamp + 30 days used as spell expiration at deployment.
Arithmetic update of the global debt ceiling: vat.Line() + (500 * MILLION * RAD) - line.
Arithmetic assignment eta = now + pause.delay().
Multiple additions/subtractions of day/hour/minute/second offsets on castTime.
External call pause.plot(action, tag, sig, eta) forwarding control to the pause proxy.
External call pause.exec(action, tag, sig, eta) performing the delegatecall execution.
External library call deauthorizing LERP from the Vat.
External library calls adjusting ilk debt ceilings for PSM-USDC-A and USDC-A.
Batch of external library calls that onboard a collateral and configure modules.
CollateralOpts struct parameter carrying all collateral configuration values.
Description string assigned to the description state variable.
Expiration timestamp assigned to the expiration immutable.
Action address assigned to the action immutable and hashed for tag.
Local VatAbstract handle resolved from DssExecLib.vat().
Local variable holding the current USDC-A ilk line read from vat.ilks.
Local result variable computing the next valid cast timestamp.

edges.reason: execute() invokes the virtual actions() implementation.
limited modifier guards the execute() entry point.
limited modifier calls officeHours() to decide whether restrictions apply.
limited modifier reads block.timestamp to compute weekday and hour.
DssSpellAction.officeHours overrides the virtual DssAction.officeHours.
DssExec.officeHours reads the action address before querying it.
DssExec.officeHours externally calls SpellAction(action).officeHours().
nextCastTime reads the action address to query office hours.
nextCastTime calls SpellAction(action).officeHours() on an external contract.
nextCastTime reads eta to derive the base cast time.
nextCastTime depends on block.timestamp for scheduling.
castTime is adjusted with timestamp-derived day/hour/minute/second arithmetic.
nextCastTime writes the castTime local variable.
DssSpell constructor reads the action_ state variable.
DssSpell constructor uses block.timestamp + 30 days as expiration.
DssSpell constructor invokes the DssExec constructor.
DssSpell constructor reads action_.description() from the deployed action.
DssExec constructor reads the log changelog to resolve MCD_PAUSE.
DssExec constructor assigns the pause proxy from the changelog.
DssExec constructor assigns the description string.
DssExec constructor assigns the expiration timestamp.
DssExec constructor assigns the action address.
DssExec constructor computes and stores the execute() signature.
DssExec constructor derives the tag from extcodehash of the action.
Constructor parameter _description feeds the description state variable.
Constructor parameter _expiration feeds the expiration immutable.
Constructor parameter _spellAction feeds action, sig and tag.
schedule() checks that the current time does not exceed expiration.
schedule() reads and writes eta.
schedule() reads pause.delay() and later calls pause.plot.
schedule() uses now for the expiration check and eta computation.
eta is computed as now + pause.delay() with unchecked timestamp arithmetic.
schedule() forwards control to the external pause proxy via plot.
cast() reads and sets the done guard flag.
cast() reads the pause proxy address.
cast() reads eta when calling pause.exec.
cast() reads the action address.
cast() reads the tag immutable.
cast() reads the sig payload.
cast() delegates execution to the external pause proxy via exec.
actions() stores the VatAbstract resolved from DssExecLib.vat().
actions() deauthorizes LERP through DssExecLib.deauthorize.
actions() adjusts ilk debt ceilings via DssExecLib.setIlkDebtCeiling.
actions() computes the new global Line with additions and a subtraction.
actions() passes the LERP constant to the deauthorize call.
actions() reads the current USDC-A line into the local variable.
addNewCollateral reads every field of the CollateralOpts parameter.
addNewCollateral performs a sequence of external DssExecLib configuration calls.
block.timestamp is consumed by nextCastTime to compute scheduling.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed by schedule().
block.timestamp is consumed by the DssSpell constructor for expiration.
block.timestamp drives the weekday/hour gating inside the limited modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: CollateralOpts parameter co is only consumed inside addNewCollateral and should be folded into that core function node.
Constructor parameter _description is directly assigned to DssExec state, merge into the DssExec constructor node.
Constructor parameter _expiration is directly assigned to the expiration immutable in the DssExec constructor.
Constructor parameter _spellAction is directly assigned to action, sig and tag in the DssExec constructor.
Local vat handle is only an alias of DssExecLib.vat() used inside actions(), merge into that function node.
Local line variable only holds vat.ilks output used by actions(), merge into that function node.
Local castTime is the direct output of nextCastTime and should be merged into that core function node.
